deadline.value: International applicants apply by December 1 (domestic December 15); year inferred for Fall 2027.
deadline.quote: The online application for Fall 2027 admission will be open, at the latest, by August, 2026 | International Applicants – December 1 at 9:59 pm Mountain Standard Time

gre_general.value: GRE General scores are no longer required and are not viewed if submitted.
gre_general.quote: the GRE General Test scores are NO LONGER REQUIRED. | your scores will not be viewed

supervisor.value: Mentorship model: the department highly recommends contacting potential faculty advisors before applying, and applicants with an advisor in place are more likely to be funded.
supervisor.quote: It is highly recommended that applicants contact potential Faculty Advisors prior to applying.

funding.value: Most incoming students get support for their first two years, often as a 50% TA or RA.
funding.quote: Typically, most incoming students are provided financial support for their first two years in our Earth Science program.

entry_route.value: A baccalaureate degree or equivalent is required; no master's needed.
entry_route.quote: Hold a baccalaureate degree or its equivalent from an accredited college or university.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: English minimums (TOEFL 80, IELTS 6.5) match the university default.
